description: This file defines a SynthEngine class for a polyphonic MIDI synthesizer, handling MIDI input, voice management, and audio output processing.

classes.name: SynthEngine
classes.description: Main class implementing a simple polyphonic MIDI synthesizer with background thread processing MIDI events and generating audio.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending MidiReceiver to handle incoming MIDI messages and dispatch to appropriate handlers.

classes.name: MyRunnable
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to run the synthesis loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.onSend to process incoming MIDI data, forwarding it if not an active sensing message.

methods.name: logMidiMessage
methods.description: Logs MIDI messages in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: processMidiEvents
methods.description: Processes scheduled MIDI events, sending MIDI messages through the framer.

methods.name: generateBuffer
methods.description: Generates audio buffer by mixing all active voices.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles note-off messages by turning off corresponding voice.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles note-on messages by creating or reusing a voice and starting it.

methods.name: pitchBend
methods.description: Adjusts pitch bend across all active voices based on MIDI bend value.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the synthesizer thread and initializes MIDI event scheduling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the synthesizer thread and cleans up resources.
